notes.title: The Devil’s Face Game Now On Sale at Steam!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43346622/8e1a46ca0d3a5f1c6980f0d80233db84de6585f8.jpg[/img]

Get ready to confront your fears head-on with our spine-chilling horror game, 'The Devil’s Face'! We're thrilled to announce that 'The Devil’s Face' is now included in the Steam's Winter Sale.

Immerse yourself in an unforgettable, terrifying world at a discounted price. This is an incredible opportunity for all horror game enthusiasts to experience the adrenaline-pumping thrills that 'The Devil’s Face' promises to deliver. If you've been waiting for the perfect moment to dive into this game, now is your chance! Don't miss out on this epic deal.

notes.title: "Into the Depths of Despair" is now available for wishlist on Steam.
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43346622/5b8951ea250690cc726a02b325f946fb17e6188c.jpg[/img]

We are excited to announce that the steam page for our new horror game, "Into the Depths of Despair," has been published. If you're interested, you can now add it to your wish list!
